settings.heading: Sultan of Statues
settings.body: Pre-owned collectible statues, bought and sold outright in the UK.

settings.heading: What we do
settings.body:
We buy and sell pre-owned resin and polystone statues from specialist studios.

Every piece is described as accurately as we can. Where we do not yet know a detail, such as the edition size, exact scale or contents of a box, we say so.

settings.heading: Talk to us about a piece
settings.body: Questions about a statue, an order or selling your statues are all welcome.
